description: Rebuild of failed build_graphql_schema. Generates GraphQL schema file for sentinel_external_api.md. Reads mcp_server_registry, mcp_signal_scores, mcp_attestations, mcp_threat_associations column names from DB_SCHEMA.md via dynamic import. Outputs schema to /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/graphql_schema.py with Query and Mutation types. Queries: mcpByName, mcpList(limit, offset), signalsForMcp, threatAssociations. Mutations: submitMcp, overrideVerdict. Resolvers are stubs that call write_service. # deps: graphql, jinja2.
